left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  diagnosed with the first ever acute ischemic stroke occurring within 2 weeks and were confirmed by CT  [OR] or MRI,
  -  has no history of depression  [OR] or use of antidepressants  [OR] or antipsychotics,
  -  were competent to consent to take part in this research

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  significant acute  [OR] or severe illness such as infection,heart failure  [OR] and tumor,
  -  previous diagnosis of depression  [OR] or other mental disorder  [OR] or who had recently accepted antidepressants  [OR] or antipsychotics,
  -  antibiotics in the last two weeks,
  -  severe aphasia  [OR] or dysarthria,irritable bowel syndrome,asthma, [OR] and pregnant  [OR] or lactating women,
  -  a previous history of neurological illness including AD  [OR] and PD，
  -  Inflammatory bowel disease，
